answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to an enclave’s remotely attested MRENCLAVE, or an equivalent measured TEE state, with evidence signed through platform-rooted hardware keys. A copied virtual machine may reproduce software and credentials, but not the measurement rooted in a distinct processor; cloning an identity therefore requires purchasing physical silicon and passing fresh attestation. An island, vertex, or jade-named agent cannot multiply cheaply in software.
